verdicts.title: Circuit Lower Bounds, Help Functions, and the Remote Point Problem
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We investigate the power of Algebraic Branching Programs (ABPs) augmented with help polynomials, and constant-depth Boolean circuits augmented with help functions. We relate the problem of proving explicit lower bounds in both these models to the Remote Point Problem (introduced by Alon, Panigrahy, and Yekhanin (RANDOM '09)). verdicts.title: Efficient Quantum Circuits for Schur and Clebsch-Gordan Transforms
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The Schur basis on n d-dimensional quantum systems is a generalization of the total angular momentum basis that is useful for exploiting symmetry under permutations or collective unitary rotations.
